title: Feedback loop: two days, five rounds
context: Built from the healthcare client's docs/dashboard.md and commit log. Feedback items are the changes recorded after each preview; wording shortened, client figures removed.

messages.name: System
messages.text: Overview cards, country and campaign drill-downs with YoY, GA4 acquisition, filters, CSV summaries and source definitions. Access: Google sign-in, exact email allowlist.

messages.name: Feedback
messages.text: Spend increases above 5% in red, decreases in green · Rank countries by the selected period's revenue · Show the current month's projection as a dotted bar · Label it ROAS and add prior-year cost to the drill-down · Move the coverage banners to Sources & Definitions

compact.title: Round 1: the first preview
compact.summary: Recorded in docs/dashboard.md as the changes requested.
items: Spend increases above 5% in red, decreases in green
Rank countries by the selected period's revenue
Show the current month's projection as a dotted bar
Label it ROAS and add prior-year cost to the drill-down

compact.title: Applied and deployed
compact.summary: 22 tests passed, plus browser checks. No console errors.
items: Projection = revenue to date ÷ completed days × days in month
Closed months and partial ranges are not projected
Moving the banners doesn't mean the data is complete

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: Current country ROAS still needs a complete export after the sheet cutoff. None is fabricated.

compact.title: The agent asks for data
compact.summary: Instead of filling the gap, it requested a manual export.
items: By day, physical user-location country and campaign
All campaign types, from 1 January
Cost, conversions, value and currency

tooltip.title: Asking, not guessing
tooltip.body: A gap in the data becomes a request to a human, not an invented number.

messages.name: Feedback
